description: WordPress wp-config.php Audit — Offline security review of a WordPress wp-config.php: config= (required; secret values are never echoed). Checks placeholder, missing or short auth keys and salts, root DB user, empty or weak DB password, WP_DEBUG with on-screen errors, public debug.log, WP_ALLOW_REPAIR, unfiltered uploads, file editor enabled, FORCE_SSL_ADMIN, http:// site URLs, disabled auto-updates, SAVEQUERIES, default wp_ table prefix and wide cookie domain. Ignores commented-out defines. Returns findings with fixes, score, grade and PASS/REVIEW/FAIL. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).

config.description: e.g. define('DB_USER','root'); define('DB_PASSWORD','pass123'); define('AUTH_KEY','put your unique phrase here'); define('WP_DEBUG', true);

name: security_wp_config_check
